title: AI-driven Small Business Answering Services | Virtual Reception & Call Management

facts.fact: ElevenLabs reports that its AI voice agents handle approximately 5,000,000 hours of conversations every month.
ElevenLabs states that its voice library offers more than 10,000 expressive voices, and users can also clone their own voice.
facts.quote: Choose from 10,000+ expressive voices (or clone yours) to match the accents and tones your callers trust most.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states that its voice agents support callers in more than 90 languages.
facts.quote: Support callers in 90+ languages with consistent tone and clarity.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states that its AI voice agents handle calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.quote: Our AI voice agents handle calls 24/7 with natural, human-like conversations.
